text:
**Yes.** The evidence identifies a corroborated 0.7-hectare tree-cover loss event in 2023, covering 1.2% of the asset. The entire event area was mapped as forest in the JRC’s 2020 reference.

The 2021 MGAP map classified 0.4 hectares of the event area as planted eucalyptus forest and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. Tree-cover loss alone does not establish whether the land was permanently converted to another use.

An additional 0.4 hectares of loss occurred in patches below the 0.5-hectare event threshold and was not counted as an event.
